problem: A bug in our HTTP client library, version 2.3.0, corrupts large gzip responses; we need it fixed
context: The bug is reported upstream. We pin exact dependency versions and have good integration tests.
key_facts: Upstream released 2.3.1 last week. Its changelog lists only this fix, and the library follows semantic versioning.
constraints: Must not delay the fix beyond this week

options.summary: Upgrade the pinned version from 2.3.0 to 2.3.1 and run the integration tests
Vendor the library into our repo and apply the upstream fix by hand
Disable gzip for large responses in our calls to work around the bug

criteria.description: Fixes the root cause with little risk of regressions

expected.why: A patch release containing only the fix is the lowest-risk, lowest-maintenance route.
